row.name: Aeluma Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=31 breakdowns=8 bursts_in_base=5 giveback=1.38 tightness=0.55 base_volume_vs_leg=0.73 base_volume_vs_avg=0.97
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 31 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; 8 4% breakdowns inside the base; the base gave back 1.38 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close -3.8% vs its 20-SMA, -14.7% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)
first leg of 28.5% in 6 sessions: his '15% plus in 10 days or less'

claude.reason: The chart shows ALMU in a persistent multi-month downtrend from ~$27 to ~$12, with all three moving averages sloping sharply lower and price well below them — there is no prior upleg to consolidate, only a declining channel. The shaded base spans 31 sessions of lower highs and lower lows with 8 breakdown days and a giveback of 1.38x the leg, which is visually a continuation of the downtrend, not a tight consolidation. The burst bar itself opens from a prior-day gap-down of 14% and closes up on lower volume than the prior session, making this look like a dead-cat bounce off a flush rather than a momentum burst from an orderly base.
claude.key_risk: Prior breakouts in this name worked only 1 of 4 times over the last 60 sessions, and the stock remains in a structural downtrend with all moving averages declining overhead as supply.
claude.entry_note: Skip at the open regardless of price action — the base and trend context disqualify this setup entirely.

row.summary: ALMU: +10.2% on 0.9× volume out of a base 41.5% deep. skip 8.0, 5 of 6 criteria.
